__comment: The food shelf (doc 299). A plank piece since doc 308 (the owner's pick A of two, 2026-11-13): two shelves between two plank ends, each end one board on edge with a notch sawn out of its foot and its front corner sawn out above the upper shelf; the lower shelf two boards, the upper one board and shallower, each pegged through the ends, within its 3 x 1 footprint. Its Tier 1 form was the lean-to rack (the owner's picks of 2026-11-06 and 2026-11-11), whose design is kept in tools/hearthblock/art/tier1.mjs. Tier 2 Hearthblock model from tools/hearthblock/art/tier2.mjs.
Carpenters make it at the carpenter's bench from four matching planks; it keeps their wood. It stands on the floor, its front to the room, and dwarves reach in from any side.

storage (ContainerStorageComponent): it holds food (stockpile_food, edible_only: only what dwarves eat, so hops, grapes and pig tail stay off its list), one crate to each of its six places, three to a deck, starting at priority 4, ahead of ground storage. Food keeps there as it would on the floor beside it (doc 42, Spoilage). The anchors are the places on its decks, in footprint-local blocks from the back-left floor corner, the upper deck first: it fills first, because the camera sees it from every side. straight: crates all stand the same way, since a turned crate would hang off the shallow upper deck.
description: Two plank shelves nailed between two plank ends, the upper one shallower. It keeps six crates of food off the floor, three to a deck.
